text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ughhh… I've really done it this time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: …Welp, something this minor'll heal in a flash.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So let's just forget this even happened and start our training fresh!
choice_data_list: You gotta take it easy for a while.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I'm fine. I just let my guard down for a second…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Argh! Just thinking about it makes me mad! How could I do something so dumb?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seriously, I'm all okay now! Please stop fussing over me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Urp… Don't look at me like thaaat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Are you doing this on purpose?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh… So it's all unintentional. What am I going to do with you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, I give up. I don't want to embarrass myself any further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't quite understand what she's saying, but I manage to convince Nice Nature to get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If you say it like that… I don't know, it makes me feel guilty all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Arrrgh, no! I'm not going back on what I said!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because I put too much pressure on her, Nice Nature ends up getting worse…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Heh… You mean that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll try to be more careful. It's the least I can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As Nice Nature promised, she quickly recovers from her injury… and her performance is better than ever!
